department: Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India (run in Tamil Nadu by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department)
benefit: If you face violence, you can get help in one place. The centre gives emergency rescue, help to file a police complaint (FIR), counselling, legal aid, and video conferencing. It helps all women and girls, at home, at work or in public. Women Helpline 181 works 24 hours, free.

other: Any woman or girl facing physical, sexual, emotional, mental or money-related abuse.
No limit by age, caste, class, religion, education or marriage status.

how_to_apply: Go to the One Stop Centre for help, or call the Women Helpline 181 at any time. 181 links you to the police, the One Stop Centre or a hospital.
where_to_apply: One Stop Centre (Sakhi) in your district, or call 181
